results.title: Frontiers | Deep Learning Analysis of Cardiac MRI in Legacy Datasets: Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis
results.content: # Deep Learning Analysis of Cardiac MRI in Legacy Datasets: Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis. The Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA), begun in 2000, was the first large cohort study to incorporate cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) to study the mechanisms of cardiovascular disease in over 5,000 initially asymptomatic participants, and there is now a wealth of follow-up data over 20 years. This study aimed to develop a fully automated CMR analysis pipeline that leverages the ability of machine learning algorithms to enable extraction of additional information from such a large-scale legacy dataset, expanding on the original manual analyses. We combined the original study analyses with new annotations to develop a set of automated methods for customizing 3D left ventricular (LV) shape models to each CMR exam and build a statistical shape atlas. Differences between the manual and automated analyses were small, i.e., <1.0 ± 2.6 mL/m2 for indexed LV volume, 3.0 ± 6.4 g/m2 for indexed LV mass, and 0.6 ± 3.3% for ejection fraction.
